:::{#exr-slr-additive}
#### Decomposing an outcome

Express each outcome $\Outvar_\iobs$ in a conditional Gaussian model (@def-cond-gaussian)
in terms of its conditional mean $\mean_\iobs$ and its deviation $\cdev_\iobs$ (@def-slr-deviation).
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-slr-additive}

Check that $\Outvar_\iobs = \mean_\iobs + \cdev_\iobs$, starting from the right-hand side:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mean_\iobs + \cdev_\iobs
&= \mean(\predvar_\iobs) + \cdev_\iobs
&& \text{(definition of $\mean_\iobs$)}\\
&= \mean(\predvar_\iobs) + \paren{\Outvar_\iobs - \mean(\predvar_\iobs)}
&& \text{(definition of $\cdev_\iobs$)}\\
&= \mean(\predvar_\iobs) + \Outvar_\iobs - \mean(\predvar_\iobs)
&& \text{(remove the parentheses)}\\
&= \Outvar_\iobs + \mean(\predvar_\iobs) - \mean(\predvar_\iobs)
&& \text{(reorder the terms)}\\
&= \Outvar_\iobs + \paren{\mean(\predvar_\iobs) - \mean(\predvar_\iobs)}
&& \text{(group the last two terms)}\\
&= \Outvar_\iobs + 0
&& \text{($a - a = 0$)}\\
&= \Outvar_\iobs
&& \text{($a + 0 = a$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

So $\Outvar_\iobs = \mean_\iobs + \cdev_\iobs$.

{{< slidebreak >}}

Alternatively, solve the definition of $\cdev_\iobs$ for $\Outvar_\iobs$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\cdev_\iobs
&= \Outvar_\iobs - \mean(\predvar_\iobs)
&& \text{(definition of $\cdev_\iobs$)}\\
\cdev_\iobs + \mean(\predvar_\iobs)
&= \Outvar_\iobs - \mean(\predvar_\iobs) + \mean(\predvar_\iobs)
&& \text{(add $\mean(\predvar_\iobs)$ to both sides)}\\
\cdev_\iobs + \mean(\predvar_\iobs)
&= \Outvar_\iobs + \paren{-\mean(\predvar_\iobs)} + \mean(\predvar_\iobs)
&& \text{(subtracting is adding the negative)}\\
\cdev_\iobs + \mean(\predvar_\iobs)
&= \Outvar_\iobs + \paren{-\mean(\predvar_\iobs) + \mean(\predvar_\iobs)}
&& \text{(group the last two terms)}\\
\cdev_\iobs + \mean(\predvar_\iobs)
&= \Outvar_\iobs + 0
&& \text{($-a + a = 0$)}\\
\cdev_\iobs + \mean(\predvar_\iobs)
&= \Outvar_\iobs
&& \text{($a + 0 = a$)}\\
\Outvar_\iobs
&= \cdev_\iobs + \mean(\predvar_\iobs)
&& \text{(swap the two sides)}\\
\Outvar_\iobs
&= \mean(\predvar_\iobs) + \cdev_\iobs
&& \text{(reorder the terms)}\\
\Outvar_\iobs
&= \mean_\iobs + \cdev_\iobs
&& \text{(definition of $\mean_\iobs$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
